artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan landing the deadline-ladder frame scheme for (W)'s obligation (i): RunLayer.lean (generic finitely-branching sliced constructor + ladderFrame, 20 pinned declarations), a ninth wired probe, C14 pair and theorem-index row, and the README (W) section with k = 1, the phase-2 obstacle, phase 3 verbatim and the HWZ/GKWZ literature paragraph; phases 2-3 of the task are characterized, not planned.

memory_candidates.content: A Lean frame constructor gated on a carrier-finiteness instance (`[Finite W]` on `ofSlicedStep`'s one `Saturation` slot) is generalized by a PARALLEL constructor whose body is the original with that one slot replaced (`saturation_of_finBranch` from two-sided finite branching), never by in-place edit when the original is referenced by wired probes. Lemmas proved in a `specs/evidence/` probe cannot be imported by the library (probes sit outside the Lake build graph and are compiled by `lake env lean`), so the library carries its own transcription and the probe then imports the library and cites it. A new library module must be added both to its directory aggregator and to the generated root `FormalSystem.lean` (`lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem --check`), and any `docs/theorem-index.md` row claiming `pinned:C14` needs a matched baseline + `#print axioms` pair in `scripts/check-module-invariants.sh`. Pinning a plan's Lean Challenge block by `lake env lean` at plan time retires instance-demand risks before implementation.
